title: Gate evidence-bound SOURCE_DEBT recovery on a materially new basis
mission: Prevent elapsed time alone from repeatedly allocating new recovery generations for jobs whose latest nonterminal BOUNDARY/SOURCE_DEBT explicitly requires a new external artifact, evidence revision, capability, or trigger. Preserve nonterminal visibility and ordinary silent-owner stale recovery; re-enable recovery only when the durable basis materially changes.
definition_of_done: Define a deterministic recovery-basis gate that distinguishes silent/stale owner recovery from evidence-bound BOUNDARY/SOURCE_DEBT attention.
For unchanged evidence-bound SOURCE_DEBT, repeated allocator builds do not emit a new recovery generation merely because the previous pin/return is older than 10 minutes.
A materially new artifact/evidence revision, newly available required capability, or explicit retry-safe trigger re-enables a deterministic next-generation recovery candidate.
Ordinary stale active-owner recovery semantics and fixed-generation contention fixtures remain unchanged.
Regression fixture reproduces Jose V11 G2 -> attempted G3 time-only churn and proves it is suppressed until a new basis is introduced.
Live/allocator projection keeps the unresolved job visible as nonterminal attention rather than falsely terminal or idle.
Run relevant allocator/recovery tests and efficiency ratchet checks.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w authority is promoted.
